The envelope features a prominent red section with reversed white text ('NIMBUS' or similar). A gondola is suspended beneath the forward section, and people are visible standing near it on the snow. The sky is clear blue.

The texture of the snow and the figures of the people appear slightly smudged and lack high-frequency detail, typical of generative smoothing in complex background areas.
